description: Image Description: The image displays a collection of sewing tools arranged on a plain, light-colored surface. In the foreground, there is a pair of metal scissors with a slightly worn appearance; the blades are long and sharp, and the handles are oval-shaped with a vintage design. The scissors have an engraved label near the pivot point that appears to include a brand name or manufacturer's mark. Positioned behind the scissors is a red, round pin cushion made of felt, which has several colorful pins inserted into it
